# Tidepool Landing Page: Revised Build Plan

## Global Decisions

**Palette:** Warm off-white background (#F7F5F0), deep teal ink (#1E3A3A) for text, seafoam (#7FC8B5) for highlights and dividers, and coral (#D9643F) for primary buttons only. Coral buttons use teal labels, not white, because white on coral fails WCAG AA. No gradients.

**Type:** Headings in Fraunces, 56px desktop and 36px mobile. Body in Inter, 18px, 1.6 line height, 65-character max line length. Minimum body contrast 4.5:1.

**Imagery:** Flat illustrations of tidepool life (anemones, hermit crabs, a single shell) used for dividers and empty states. Product screenshots are the only photographic-style imagery. No stock photos of people at laptops.

**Copy rules:** Plain, specific, verb-first. Never claim a number we can't back up. Until real data exists, use qualitative claims, not invented statistics.

**Success metric:** Click-through from hero "Start free" to sign-up completion. Secondary: scroll depth past the pricing section.

---

## Sections, Top to Bottom

**1. Navigation**
Logo left. Links: Product, Pricing, Stories. Right side: "Log in" text link and coral "Start free" button. Sticky, with a 1px seafoam divider after 24px of scroll. On mobile, collapse to a menu icon, and keep "Start free" visible in the bar.

**2. Hero**
Two columns: copy left (55%), product screenshot right. The screenshot is cropped at the bottom edge so it appears to rise from the fold.
- Headline: "One board for everyone's week."
- Subhead: "Tidepool gives small teams a shared weekly plan, so nobody has to ask what's happening Monday."
- Primary CTA: "Start free." Secondary: "Watch a 60-second tour" (opens an inline video, not a new page).
- Micro-line: "Free for teams up to 5. No card required."
- Mobile: screenshot moves below copy, cropped the same way.

**3. Proof Strip**
Full-width seafoam band at 20% opacity. Three factual items in semibold teal: "Teams of 2 to 12 people," "Connects to Slack and Google Calendar," "Free for up to 5 people." Replace with real customer counts once available.

**4. The Problem**
Centered column, 640px max. Headline: "Your week lives in six chat threads." Two-sentence body naming specific pain: who's covering the client call, what got decided Tuesday. Visual: left side, a stack of chat bubbles drawn as tangled shells; right side, one neat row of shells. Keep the contrast literal and simple.

**5. How It Works**
Three cards in a row, numbered 01 to 03 in Fraunces. Each card has a time label.
- "Add the week's goals" (Monday, 5 minutes): one sentence per task.
- "Claim what you'll own" (Monday, 5 minutes): drag names onto items.
- "Check in Friday" (Friday, 2 minutes): an automatic recap lands in Slack.
Under 12 words per card description.

**6. Product Tour**
Alternating layout: a 20-second looping animation of the board filling in across a week, on the left. Right side: headline "See the whole team's week at a glance," then three bullets with small icons: shared board, workload view, async Friday recap. Coral annotation callouts appear on the animation, not in the text.

**7. Testimonials**
Three quote cards on white with thin teal borders. Each card gives role and team size, plus one specific outcome. Example format: "We cut our Monday standup from 40 minutes to 10." Use only quotes with written permission. If fewer than three exist at launch, show one founder-led quote and a small "Early access team" note instead of placeholder testimonials.

**8. Pricing**
Two tiers side by side: Free (up to 5 people) and Team ($6 per seat per month, or $4.80 billed annually). Annual toggle labeled "Save 20%." Show a worked example beneath: "A team of 5 on Team pays $30 a month." Coral CTA appears only on Team. Plain feature lists, no comparison matrix.

**9. FAQ**
Single-column accordion, six questions, answers under 40 words each. Include:
- Can we cancel anytime?
- Does it replace our project tool?
- Who can see our plans?
- What happens when we pass five people on Free?
- Can we import from a spreadsheet?
- Which integrations are live today?

**10. Final CTA**
Full-bleed teal background, off-white text. Headline: "Your next Monday starts with a plan." One coral button labeled "Start free." Tidepool illustration in the bottom-right corner, scaled down on mobile.

**11. Footer**
Four columns: Product, Company, Resources, Legal. Small wordmark bottom-left. Include a security and data-handling page link and a status page link, since small teams often check both before buying.

---

## Mobile and Behavior Notes

- Sticky bottom bar on mobile after the hero, with "Start free" only. It hides when the pricing section is in view to avoid competing CTAs.
- Accordion and tabs must be keyboard operable. Focus rings in teal, 2px.
- Animations respect `prefers-reduced-motion` and show the final frame as a still image.

## Metadata

- Title: "Tidepool: Plan your team's week together"
- Description: "A shared weekly board for small teams. Set up in ten minutes. Free for up to 5 people."
